data.name: Hôtel ibis Annecy Centre Vieille Ville
data.hotelDescription:
Prime Location
Located in the heart of Annecy Old Town, Hôtel ibis Annecy Centre Vieille Ville offers easy access to popular attractions such as Lake Annecy and Thiou.

Outstanding Amenities
Enjoy a range of amenities including bicycle rentals, complimentary Wi-Fi, and an on-site bar/lounge, Rendez-vous, providing the perfect spot for dinner or snacks.

Comfortable Accommodations
Relax in one of the 85 guestrooms with LED televisions, free Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. The hotel also offers buffet breakfasts and a computer station for your convenience.

To book your stay at Hôtel ibis Annecy Centre Vieille Ville and experience the charm of Annecy, reserve now!

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Multiple guests explicitly noted rooms, bathrooms and lobby were clean and tidy; overall positive cleanliness impressions with no major housekeeping complaints.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Staff repeatedly praised as friendly, helpful and courteous (specific mentions of reception/bar staff, Christine and a desk employee who went above and beyond), supporting a very strong service rating.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Consistently described as perfect/very good — right next to the old town, near the train/bus station, markets and restaurants; parking adjacent was also frequently mentioned.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Rooms described as clean but basic; some guests noted small/low-ceiling rooms (room 233), dated decor, and occasional street noise — solid but with clear areas for improvement.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Breakfast described as ample/decent, bike rentals available, adjacent parking and a pleasant lobby (e.g., flavored water on arrival); amenities are good for the hotel’s segment.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Several reviewers called it good value or reasonably priced for the location and level of service, supporting an above-target value score.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast was described as decent (boiled eggs, fruit, bread/cheese/jam); acceptable but not highlighted as exceptional.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Most reviewers said they enjoyed their stay, would recommend or stay again; minor issues (noise, small rooms) did not outweigh the very positive overall impressions.
